entries.sense_en: rolled up tightly and fastened around its pole

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general; no sense of fastening to a pole or mast.
Bends flat material over itself; furling rolls it tight.
Covers something all around; furling wraps flag or sail on its own pole.

entries.sense_en: looking shorter than it really is because seen from a steep angle

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for making shorter; no idea of viewing angle.
Squeeze into less space; suggests pressure, not perspective.

entries.sense_en: completely filled or covered with (a colour or light)

synonyms.nuance: Wet all through; usually liquid, literal.
Lit gently all over; a softer, more pleasant image.
Deeply involved or covered; often used for activities and study.

entries.sense_en: by means of; through the effort of

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; does not stress effort.
Gives credit, often for a lucky or helpful cause.
Plainer and shorter; no note of hard effort.

entries.tip_ko: dint /dɪnt/는 원래 '힘, 타격'이란 뜻으로, 'by dint of hard work'처럼 노력을 강조할 때 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: very steep, like a sudden drop

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for any sharp slope.
Vertical or nearly so, like a cliff face.
Sudden; used for change or stops more than for slopes.

entries.sense_en: unpleasantly cold, damp and slightly sticky

synonyms.nuance: Slightly wet; can be pleasant or neutral.
Cold, wet and smelling of decay, like a cellar.
Pleasantly wet, often of food like cake.

entries.sense_en: soft and wet, with water slowly seeping out

synonyms.nuance: Covered in or full of mud; more ordinary.
Slippery and disgusting, like slime.
Soaked and heavy; often bread or ground after rain.

entries.sense_en: (of skin) a sickly yellowish colour

synonyms.nuance: Lacking colour; not necessarily unhealthy or yellow.
Unhealthily pale, more formal and stronger than pale.
Pale and tired-looking, often from grief or illness.

entries.sense_en: causing gloom; bleak and depressing

synonyms.nuance: Dark or sad; the most common word.
Dull and boring as well as sad.
Empty and cold, with no hope or comfort.

entries.sense_en: having sharp, uneven points and edges

synonyms.nuance: General; any uneven surface, not necessarily pointed.
Regular small teeth like a saw or bread knife.
Rocky, steep and rugged, used of cliffs and faces.

entries.sense_en: a dark underground prison; here, the deep gloomy railway cutting
entries.sense_ko: 지하 감옥 (여기서는 감옥 같은 깊은 철도 골짜기)

synonyms.nuance: Ordinary word for a place of punishment.
A single small room for one prisoner.
Deep hole; no idea of imprisonment.

entries.sense_en: looking unfriendly and frightening, warning you to stay away

synonyms.nuance: Suggests a real threat of harm.
Stern and joyless, not always threatening.
Makes a task feel too hard rather than a place unfriendly.

entries.sense_en: held (my attention) completely

synonyms.nuance: Quick and informal; may not last.
Interest that is pleasant and deep.
Neutral; keeps attention without the strong pull of rivet.

entries.tip_ko: be riveted to/by ~ 는 '~에 시선이 꽂히다'라는 뜻으로 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: over there, at a distance

synonyms.nuance: What people say today; neutral.
Stresses distance, not pointing at a place.

entries.sense_en: made me feel nervous and unsure

synonyms.nuance: Frighten by power or manner, usually on purpose.
Make suddenly uneasy and lose confidence.
Take away hope or the wish to try.

entries.sense_en: looked at carefully and studied

synonyms.nuance: Look closely to find details or faults.
Even more careful; often suspicious.
Look quickly without care; nearly the opposite.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어에서는 '대충 훑어보다'로도 쓰여 뜻이 엇갈립니다.

entries.sense_en: gloomy, serious and cold in manner

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; can describe weather or mood.
Bad-tempered and silent as well as sad.
Stern, humourless and unsmiling.

entries.sense_en: present but hidden, not yet showing

synonyms.nuance: General; may be hidden on purpose.
Sleeping now but able to wake, like a volcano.
Lies beneath the surface as a base cause.

entries.sense_en: however hard I tried (I could not say)

synonyms.nuance: Same idea; dramatic exaggeration.
synonyms.example: I couldn't remember, to save my life

synonyms.word: no matter how hard I try
synonyms.nuance: Plain modern wording; no exaggeration.
synonyms.example: I can't remember, no matter how hard I try

entries.modern: "for my life" → "for the life of me"

entries.sense_en: move backwards suddenly in surprise or fear

synonyms.nuance: Move away in fear or disgust; a stronger, more formal word.
Small quick movement from fear or pain.
Deliberate and calm, with no shock.

entries.sense_en: simple and rough, not skilled or complete

synonyms.nuance: Not exact or finished; can be neutral.
Very simple and early in development.
Lacking polish or refinement; a little more formal.

entries.tip_ko: 'crude'는 '저속한'(a crude joke), '가공하지 않은'(crude oil)이란 뜻도 있어 문맥으로 구분하세요.

entries.sense_en: a mismatch between a person and their surroundings

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for things that do not fit together.
A difference between facts or figures that should agree.
Parts that contradict each other, in logic or behaviour.

entries.sense_en: live without discipline and waste one's chances

synonyms.nuance: Leave the right path; less about lack of control.
Simply act badly; no long-term waste of life.
Deliberately fight against rules and authority.

entries.match: made his bed, and he lay upon it
entries.headword: make one's bed and lie in it
entries.sense_en: he accepted the results of his own choices

synonyms.nuance: Bad actions bring bad results; more moral warning.
Accept punishment or criticism for what you did.
synonyms.example: he had to face the music

entries.tip_ko: 보통 'You've made your bed, now lie in it.'으로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: always watching carefully for danger

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for keeping an eye on things.
Quick to notice and react; can be brief.
Careful because you distrust; less about duty.

entries.sense_en: far apart

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, general word.
In different places or ways, with no sense of distance.

entries.sense_en: impossible to explain or understand

synonyms.nuance: Strange and hard to know; often exciting.
No reason or cause can be found; a little formal.
So confusing that you cannot work it out.

entries.sense_en: to encourage him to keep talking, or to trust me

synonyms.nuance: Gently persuade someone to do or say something.
Get someone to reveal thoughts or feelings.
Keep misleading someone for your own benefit; dishonest.

entries.sense_en: tell (a secret or information) to someone

synonyms.nuance: Get across ideas or feelings, by any means.
Reveal something secret or hidden.
Plain everyday word; less formal.

entries.sense_en: waving arms and hands wildly to express something

synonyms.nuance: Any movement of the hand to show meaning; can be calm.
Move the hand or arm back and forth.
Move arms wildly without control or purpose.

entries.sense_en: very strong, forceful feeling

synonyms.nuance: Strong feeling, can be love or joy.
Wild anger, more violent than vehemence.
Power in action or words; not always emotional.

entries.sense_en: (voice) rough and weak, as after long shouting

synonyms.nuance: Rough in a low, often attractive way.
Rough and unfriendly in manner.
Weak and scratchy, like a frog, from a cold.

entries.sense_en: very strong hatred and disgust

synonyms.nuance: Deep hate mixed with disgust; also common.
Feeling sick at something unpleasant.
Much weaker, ordinary word.

entries.sense_en: a sudden shaking movement of the body from fear

synonyms.nuance: Small shaking from cold or fear; more general.
Longer, continuous shaking, from fear or weakness.
Quick light shaking, of body parts or voice.

entries.sense_en: considered when judging or deciding

synonyms.nuance: General; think about carefully.
Add extra to cover something you expect.
Informal; include as one part of a calculation.

entries.sense_en: a ghost, especially a frightening one

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a dead person's spirit.
A ghost or illusion, often seen briefly.
Sudden ghostly appearance; formal.

entries.sense_en: frightening in a deathlike, horrible way

synonyms.nuance: General bad; no idea of death.
Bloody and shocking to see.
Like death, especially of pale colour or silence.

entries.sense_en: a long, sad, high crying sound
entries.sense_ko: 길게 우는 듯한 소리, 통곡 소리

synonyms.nuance: Low sound of pain or complaint.
Loud long cry, of animals, wind or grief.
Crying with short catching breaths.

entries.sense_en: stopping and starting again and again, not steadily

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; an irregular pattern over time.
Formal; happening with gaps.
Occasionally and unpredictably.

entries.sense_en: thinking deeply and slowly about something

synonyms.nuance: Weigh something carefully; can be short.
Think unhappily for a long time.
Think dreamily, often speaking aloud.

entries.sense_en: a sudden terrible disaster

synonyms.nuance: General for any very bad event.
Larger, with lasting ruin.
Milder bad luck.

entries.sense_en: prevented (something bad) from happening

synonyms.nuance: General; stop anything happening.
Keep away from something, or keep it from happening to you.
Keep back a threat, often for a time.

entries.sense_en: careful to do one's duty well

synonyms.nuance: Hard-working over time.
Does what is expected out of duty.
Very careful about small details.

entries.sense_en: carried out (a duty) fully

synonyms.nuance: Do a task; general.
Do what was promised or needed.
Everyday phrase for do a plan or order.

entries.sense_en: betraying someone's trust

synonyms.nuance: Not faithful; milder than treacherous.
Lying in order to trick.
Breaking a promise, esp. in love.

entries.sense_en: informed; told

synonyms.nuance: General, neutral word.
Officially tell, often in writing.
Formal 'let know'; also means give advice.

entries.sense_en: the very edge of a steep place

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for any side or limit.
Edge of a road, or point before something happens.
Round edge of a cup or hole.

entries.sense_en: heavy waterproof cloth used as a cover

synonyms.nuance: Short, casual form.
Strong cloth; not always waterproof.
Any thin flat cover.

entries.sense_en: calm and peaceful

synonyms.nuance: Quiet and not upset; general.
Peaceful and untroubled, almost beautiful.
Self-controlled in a difficult moment.

entries.sense_en: to pay attention and act on a warning

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; only listening or watching.
See or hear something; no need to act.
Do as told; heed suggests choice, not order.
